editorial.thesis: A mixed-economy city of about 53,000. Its retail is heavy on banks & atms, and thin on restaurants & fast food and cafés, tea & coffee — and 0% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.

The mapped economy is close to Jaipur's mix. Shares of all mapped places: . Raw counts would mislead because Jaipur is mapped more completely (38,142 places against 28), so we compare mix, not counts.
No large under-served zone. No zone combines a large resident base with retail depth below 60% of the city average; the thin spots are small and scattered.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 5 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Jaipur, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. City and Barodia are the largest zones by residents (12,000 and 6,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 12% of all commercial places, and City alone lists 7.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. City holds 0 of the 0 tracked chain outlets, and Barodia adds 0.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. City and Barodia lead on education places (1 and 0, with 0 and 0 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. There is no large amber area. The blue cores include City.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (38,142 places in Jaipur against 28 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Jaipur; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Jaipur, Banswara's mapped places match the benchmark mix.

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 0 outlets of 0 tracked national brands within 5 km — 0.0 per lakh residents against Jaipur's 20.27 (448 outlets of 39 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Jaipur are Apollo Pharmacy (0 vs 70); Café Coffee Day (0 vs 43); Domino's (0 vs 30). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Jaipur's, so low means thin by Jaipur's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 5 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Banswara's age mix against Jaipur: children (0–14) 37.0% vs 27.9%, 15–24 19.0% vs 21.1%, working age 37.5% vs 44.1%, 60+ 6.5% vs 6.9%. Under-25s are 56% of residents.

zones.327001: A commercial core: 7 mapped places and 0 chain outlets (0% of the city's tracked chains) for about 12,000 residents. A destination zone, so much of its footfall likely lives elsewhere.
zones.327604: About 6,000 residents, 2 mapped places (retail depth index 106), 0 chain outlets.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 0.0% of mapped places against 4.9% in Jaipur — below its share. No mapped outlet in either city: Haldiram's, Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 0.0% of mapped places against 2.9% in Jaipur — below its share. No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Point, Third Wave Coffee.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.0% of mapped places against 0.7% in Jaipur — below its share. No mapped outlet in either city: Theobroma, Cream Stone.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 0.0% of mapped places against 1.3% in Jaipur — below its share. No mapped outlet in either city: More, Star Bazaar.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 0.0% of mapped places against 1.0% in Jaipur — below its share. No mapped outlet in either city: MedPlus, Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 0.0% of mapped places against 7.1% in Jaipur — below its share.
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 10.7% of mapped places against 7.3% in Jaipur — above its share.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 0.0% of mapped places against 3.3% in Jaipur — below its share.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 0.0% of mapped places against 3.7% in Jaipur — below its share.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
